## 🎮 CosmoU for Wii U

**`CosmoU-WiiU-0.13.0.wuhb`** is CosmoU as an app on the Wii U itself. It shows the games installed on your Wii U (system memory, USB drive and disc) in CosmoU's look, with Covers and Grid views and themes with their music, and starts them, on the TV and the GamePad.

**🛍️ Shop:** press **+** (or tap **Shop**) to install things right on the Wii U:
- **Emulators:** RetroArch (NES, SNES, Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance in one app), NooDS (Nintendo DS) and other emulators
- **Apps:** the whole [Homebrew App Store](https://hb-app.store) catalog by ForTheUsers (apps installed in CosmoU also show up as installed there, and the other way round)
- **Themes:** the 17 other CosmoU themes with their music (Classic Wii, Plaza, Switch 2, DS, DSi, 3DS, GameCube, Game Boy, Virtual Boy, SNES, NES, Game & Watch, Game Boy Pocket, Game Boy Color, GBA, GBA SP, Game Boy Micro)
- **Fonts:** Rounded, Soft, Pixel, Arcade and Condensed

The shop only has homebrew, themes and fonts: no games, ROMs, BIOS files or keys.

**Install:** you need a Wii U with the [Aroma](https://aroma.foryour.cafe/) homebrew environment.
1. Copy `CosmoU-WiiU-0.13.0.wuhb` to your SD card into `wiiu/apps/`.
2. Put the SD card back into the Wii U and start **CosmoU** from the Wii U Menu.

**Controls:** D-pad or stick to move · **A** start · **Y** Covers / Grid · **X** theme · **+** shop · **−** music on/off · the touch screen works too. In the shop: **L / R** tabs · **A** install / use · **X** remove · **B** back.

This Wii U version belongs to 0.13.0 and has no update check.
